contract.factorization: Checked CPU ILUT/ILUTP; preserves drop, fill and pivot configuration. Host factor import also preserves symmetric ordering.
contract.action: Native CSR gather, shared dependency-level lower/upper solves, native CSR scatter; no per-application backend allocation or H2D/D2H.
contract.permutations: Gather with perm[new]=old; final scatter maps each factor step to perm[col_perm[step]].
contract.refresh: Compatible factors refresh in place without backend allocation. Changed permutations or factor sparsity return false before mutation. Failed upload invalidates application until successful refresh.
contract.quota: Backend-owned allocations follow existing quota policy; no new total-memory guarantee.

fixtures.factor_parity: f32/f64/Complex32/Complex64; 13 rows; drop 1e-3, fill 3; pivoting on/off; natural and non-involutive symmetric ordering; three RHS applications per case
fixtures.negative_gates: Invalid diagnostics/nonfinite or zero inverse pivots/permutations; changed permutation and factor pattern; partial refresh failure/recovery; injected application launch failure preserves output
fixtures.resolved_pml: Existing axisymmetric resolved acoustic producer: 61-node coarse sigma=2 fixture and 191-node default sigma=18 fixture; 400/450 Hz; two complex drives per frequency; model restart/iteration/tolerance controls; CPU direct field reference
fixtures.pml_iterations: Coarse: 3 per solve; default: 5 per solve. Warmed RHS solves allocate zero backend buffers. Matrix update replaces preconditioner while retaining physical operator/Krylov session.

validation.cuda_clippy: passed with existing warnings; no warning in changed CUDA files

limitations: Public resolved-speaker continuation/full-result APIs still use CPU solves; this qualifies their assembled matrices through the existing public persistent FGMRES API.

Host factorization remains CPU work; long dependency chains can require many GPU launches.
PML fixtures do not establish mesh convergence, low-frequency robustness, product-scale performance or a speedup.
Full compute/solver/BEM/FEM CUDA coverage remains incomplete.
